top_comments.text: It might look cool. Remember if they are wowed and nobody remembers whose website this is, it actually fails. By the way, don't make the logo bigger. The content and the story, the focus on the ICP really are the most important. But usually really good design is subtraction, what can I remove. That might mean all the fancy stuff on the website, but it will make you a better designer. I sincerely hope I didn't rain on your parade
